title: Add description auto-copy and change currency to Australian dollars

requirements.text: Update the auto-copy functionality in the BulkProductUpload component (frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx) to include the description field when copying from the first item to subsequent items. When auto-copy is enabled, the description from the first product should be copied to all other products along with title, price, inventory count, and category.

quotes: Make item description copy from first item also when uploading

acceptanceCriteria: When auto-copy is enabled in BulkProductUpload, the description field from the first product is automatically copied to all subsequent products
The description field updates in real-time when the first product's description changes
Image fields remain independent and are not copied
Manual edits to individual product descriptions are still possible after auto-copy

requirements.text: Change the platform currency from the current default to Australian dollars (AUD) across all components displaying prices, including ProductCard, ProductDetailView, ProductManagementTable, Checkout, ShoppingBasket, and Dashboard components. Update price formatting to use AUD currency symbol ($) with 'AUD' label where appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: All price displays show Australian dollar formatting with '$' symbol
Currency is labeled as 'AUD' where appropriate (e.g., in checkout summaries)
Price inputs and displays are consistent across all frontend components
Existing price values are preserved and only the display format changes

requirements.text: Update the backend createStripeCheckoutSession method in backend/main.mo to configure Stripe checkout sessions with Australian dollars (AUD) as the currency instead of the current default currency.
acceptanceCriteria: Stripe checkout sessions are created with currency set to 'aud'
All payment amounts are processed in Australian dollars
Existing Stripe integration continues to work with the new currency
Currency configuration is applied to all checkout flows (single product and multi-item)

constraints: Do not modify the backend single-actor architecture
Do not edit files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve all existing auto-copy functionality for other fields (title, price, inventory count, category)
nonGoals: Adding support for multiple currencies or currency selection
Changing the pricing model or calculation logic
Modifying how prices are stored in the backend
